card.name: Botanical descriptions before 'or' alternatives
card.fires_on: The last word of a short descriptive term in plant descriptions (e.g. glabrous, entire, erect), where an 'or' alternative often comes next. Weaker on similar spots in drug-label phrases.

modes.label: Plant trait terms
modes.description: A trait adjective in a flora description, such as glabrous, entire or erect, often followed by 'or' or a parenthetical.

card.writes: It promotes 'or' words in several languages and suppresses 'and' words, so it favors an alternative over a addition.
card.plain: It fires where a described feature is complete and the text may continue with 'or' to give an alternative.
